changeinfo.changes: Patch includes voiceover data for English, French, and German.

Justice System The justice system has been put into place in the world. Players can now participate in unlawful activities such as stealing, breaking and entering and murdering. All these pieces are PvE only. There is no new PvP interactions implemented. The world comes alive with this new system by providing users with world reactions to their actions. Citizens may run away or scold a player for killing another NPC or stealing. Guards have been put in place around the word to help keep order among the players and deter players from participating in illegal activities. Players also now have the option to visit a fence who can help them pay off their bounty or buy their stolen items. Most players will benefit with the availability of new items acquired from their thieving. There is a new skill line that will help players increase their ability for their nefarious actions.
Champion Systems A new way to improve characters is now available to players. After any character has reached a veteran rank on an account all characters are now eligible to use champions points. Points can be spent on any of the nine constellations available and each constellation belongs to a group that has a specific focus. This was put in place to help create a broader sense of abilities and bonus’ for players once at least one of their characters has reached a veteran level. Everything that a player can do to earn experience also counts towards them gaining champion points.
Game Rebalance With the champion system, abilities, stats and bonus’ were recalculated to help balance the game. The game now requires very specific focus on a particular stat and work towards maxing it out over several areas, apparel, skill lines and champion system.
Other Major Gameplay Changes Almost every ability has had one kind of change or another.
Animation Updates Animations have been reworked to behave smoother. Combat should feel more responsive and look more natural for all players.
Provisioning Revamp Provisioning items have been reworked so that recipes require less unique items. Provisioners should now be able to craft more items with ingredients on hand instead of having to search for alliance/rank specific items. Players are now able to take more food items from the world and either use them to create new food items or consume them for low end buffs.
Collection System Some inventory items are being transferred into the new collections system. This takes these out of the players total bag count and has their own inventory section. These include vanity pets, mounts and costumes. Mounts have been revamped for this new system in that players will take riding lessons to upgrade their mounted stats. All collection items should be available for all characters on an account.
Crown Store The in game market place will be in place. Players will be able to purchase Pets, Mounts, Costumes, Consumables and Bundles. Players will be able to purchase crowns from first party stores and then use those crowns at the in game crown store for these items.
Trial Leaderboard Changes Leaderboard scores are now based off of points.
Updated Tutorial The tutorial quest has been updated to give players a better understanding of game mechanics.
AvA We are looking to enable a campaign on this At Home test. We are unsure if the campaign will be available through the whole thing or not, but this is functionality that was not in our At Home 1 that we would like to see running, if not supported, this round.
UI More UI screens have been updated to the console configuration as well as many fixes have gone in to create a better game experience.
Bug Fixes • We have fixed the lengthy scroll time for the legal document before entering game • The problem where game audio would drop out piece by piece has been significantly reduced, if not completely removed. • Various other fixes have been implemented to make overall game experience better including UI and crash fixes.
